title: Why does a hot-air box oven need fresh air if it already has recirculation?
summary: A 2023 Suneng hot-air chamber-furnace proposal separately provides external recirculating heating and fresh-air replacement controlled by oxygen measurement. Recirculation sends furnace air through an external heating chamber and back; fresh-air replacement exhausts used gas and introduces new air according to oxygen readings. Review each system's purpose and control conditions separately.
